name: Kang-Petrov Arms KPS-7V 'Verdict'
description:
The KPS-7V Verdict is Kang-Petrov's heavy-caliber SMG, chambered in .45 ACP caseless — an old cartridge concept rendered in modern caseless form. The Verdict prioritizes stopping power over penetration, delivering heavy, slow projectiles that transfer maximum energy to the target. Against unarmored opponents, the .45 caseless round is devastating. Against body armor, it is a firm shove.

The weapon's design is deliberately retro-futurist, with angular polymer furniture over a stamped steel receiver that echoes mid-20th-century submachine guns. Kang-Petrov's design team included historical weapons enthusiasts who wanted to prove that heavy-caliber SMGs remained tactically relevant in an era of high-velocity micro-calibers. The Verdict's 25-round magazine and 600 rpm cyclic rate provide sustained close-range firepower with terminal effects that smaller calibers struggle to match.

At Φ1,500, the Verdict appeals to operators who value knockdown power and operators who appreciate the weapon's aggressive aesthetic. In Tier 2-3 zones where body armor is rare, the .45 caseless round's stopping power makes the Verdict genuinely terrifying at close range. In zones where armor is common, it is a relic outclassed by armor-piercing alternatives.
specifications:
caliber: .45 ACP caseless
effective_range: 75m
rate_of_fire: 600 rpm (cyclic)
magazine_capacity: 25 rounds
weight: 2.6 kg
tactical_use: The Verdict excels against unarmored targets at close range. Its heavy .45 caseless round delivers stopping power that lighter calibers cannot match, putting targets down with fewer hits. In environments where body armor is uncommon — Tier 1-2 zones, criminal enforcement, wildlife defense — the Verdict's terminal performance is superior to lighter-caliber alternatives. Against armored opponents, operators should switch to AP-capable platforms.
cultural_context: The Verdict has a cult following driven by its combination of retro aesthetics and modern performance. Weapons collectors prize its design language, and street operators appreciate its visceral stopping power. The weapon has appeared in several popular media properties, boosting its cultural visibility beyond its tactical merits. In some communities, carrying a Verdict is a fashion statement as much as a tactical choice.
story_hooks: A media personality popularized the Verdict in a streaming series, causing demand to spike 400%. Kang-Petrov can't manufacture them fast enough, and counterfeit Verdicts are flooding the market with dangerous quality variations.
A series of enforcement killings all used .45 ACP caseless ammunition — a caliber rare enough that the supply chain is traceable to a single distributor.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately retro-futurist submachine gun that channels mid-20th-century design language through a neo-noir lens. Angular, aggressive profile with a prominent forward grip and squared-off receiver. The weapon has a chunky, purposeful stance despite its SMG classification — less sleek operative tool, more bruiser's cudgel. Immediately reads as a heavy-hitting close-quarters platform.
physical_description.dimensions: 42 cm overall length, 28 cm barrel length, 7 cm width across magazine well. Compact enough for CQB work but with a substantial footprint that telegraphs its power.
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty and reassuring in the hand — 2.6 kg of stamped steel and reinforced polymer that feels capable of delivering punishment. Not light, but well-balanced despite the forward-heavy magazine configuration. Solid and deliberate when shouldered.
physical_description.primary_material: Stamped steel receiver with reinforced polymer furniture. The frame uses a hybrid construction typical of Kang-Petrov's cost-conscious design philosophy — expensive precision where it matters (breach, bolt carrier), cost-saving stampwork elsewhere.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal receiver with scattered wear marks suggesting frequent handling. Polymer panels in tactical black with light scratches and minor scuff marks. Industrial, unpolished aesthetic without chrome or reflective surfaces.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray stamped steel contrasted with matte black polymer grips and foregrip. Minimal accent color — subtle bronze-toned charging handle and selector markings provide minimal visual relief.
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive checkered polymer grip with raised texturing for positive purchase. The magazine well guard and foregrip feature diamond-pattern texturing. Everything designed for positive control during sustained fire.
distinctive_features: Angular magazine well with pronounced feed lips — caseless ammunition requires precision engineering visible at the top of the mag
Oversized charging handle at 45-degree angle, bronze-anodized with aggressive serration
Heavy-profile barrel with subtle muzzle brake vents cut into the crown
Cocking handle mounted to left side of receiver, recessed to prevent snags
Manual ambidextrous safety lever with aggressive witness marks
Heat vents machined into polymer handguard panels in geometric patterns
Picatinny rail sections top and bottom, painted flat black
Stamped serial numbers on left receiver panel, deeply scored
Kang-Petrov shield logo inlaid into right side polymer panel using contrasting black polymer insert
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Kang-Petrov ARMS stamped along the left receiver in serif lettering, aged appearance suggesting post-manufacture oxidation. Model designation KPS-7V scored into upper receiver. Serial plate on left side uses recessed numbering filled with dark enamel. Country of manufacture mark (GLMZ-licensed) stamped in small text on barrel journal.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but maintained. Light surface oxidation on the stamped receiver. Polymer shows handling marks and minor scuffs. Evidence of regular cleaning and care — no corrosion in critical areas, but deliberately unglamorous finish that hides wear patterns. This is a working weapon, not a collector's piece.
